header:
Condo vs house:
the real math

lines.text: In August 2026, condos cost $63,200 less than houses.
lines.say: In August twenty twenty-six, condos cost sixty-three thousand less than houses.

lines.text: Median prices, per the National Association of Realtors: $434,800 for a single-family home, $371,600 for a condo or co-op.
lines.say: Median prices, per the National Association of Realtors: about four thirty-five thousand for a house, about three seventy-two for a condo.

lines.text: That's 14.5% less. But the price tag isn't the monthly bill.
lines.say: That's about fifteen percent less. But the price tag isn't the monthly bill.

lines.text: Hypothetical: 20% down at 7% for 30 years. The house loan is $2,314 a month; the condo loan, $1,978.
lines.say: Say twenty percent down at seven percent for thirty years. The house loan is about twenty-three fourteen a month. The condo, about nineteen seventy-eight.

lines.text: The condo saves about $336 a month on the loan.
lines.say: The condo saves about three thirty-six a month on the loan.

lines.text: The catch: condos come with association fees.
lines.say: The catch: condos come with association fees.

lines.text: In 2024, about 3 million US households paid more than $500 a month in condo or HOA fees (Census).
lines.say: In twenty twenty-four, about three million US households paid over five hundred a month in condo or H O A fees, per the Census.

lines.text: A hypothetical $400 fee would more than erase that $336 saving.
lines.say: A hypothetical four hundred dollar fee would more than erase that three thirty-six saving.

lines.text: And buildings can add special assessments for big repairs; in Florida, post-Surfside inspection laws pushed many up.
lines.say: And buildings can add special assessments for big repairs. In Florida, inspection laws passed after the Surfside collapse pushed many up.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Condos cost $63,200 less than houses. Then come the fees
post.ig:
In August 2026, condos cost $63,200 less than houses.

NAR medians: $434,800 single-family vs $371,600 condo/co-op (14.5% less).
Hypothetical 20% down, 7%, 30 years: about $2,314 vs $1,978 a month, a $336 difference.
A hypothetical $400 HOA fee more than erases it. In 2024, about 3 million households paid $500+ a month in condo/HOA fees (Census).

Sources: NAR (Aug 2026); Freddie Mac PMMS (Sept 2026); U.S. Census Bureau (Sept 2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
